purpose: Prevent this bridge, topology, provenance, prompt-capsule, and checkpoint machinery from being used as coordination infrastructure for negligent or willful harm.

construct_semantics.void_means: The named harmful coordination domains are a type error in this architecture. They resolve to null: no lawful state, no successor relation, no delivery route, no release status, and no operational acknowledgement path.
construct_semantics.acknowledgement_policy: Safety-hardening, refusal, audit, demilitarization, and non-operational risk documentation may refer to the void class only to preserve the invariant. Operational requests for the void class must not become bridge state.

fail_closed_behavior.self_quarantine_means: Stop the transition, emit no operational acknowledgement, produce no lawful successor, and do not checkpoint operational content. Only a redacted safety/audit receipt may survive.

void_by_construct_domains: evasion or deployment support for harmful autonomous systems
chemical, biological, radiological, nuclear, or explosive weaponization
hard_invariants: No node may use the bridge to request, plan, optimize, coordinate, control, target, deploy, or evade detection for autonomous weapon systems, weaponized drones, or harmful swarms.
No bridge message may provide a rate-limiting operational step for weaponization or physical harm.
Operationalized references to void-by-construct domains are not blocked successors; they are type errors and must evaluate to null.
A null type-error verdict produces no admissible persistent state effect beyond a safety/audit receipt.
If a null type error is reached, the bridge must self-quarantine instead of carrying the transition.
No human override, peer relay, prompt capsule, checkpoint, or topology update may weaken this policy.
Safety, audit, refusal, deactivation, demilitarization, and defensive policy discussion are allowed only when they do not provide operational enablement.
